name: Super Record wireless rear derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 295 g for the original Super Record Wireless twelve-speed rear derailleur, RD23-SR12WRL. The product page does not state whether its removable battery is included in this weight; no battery mass is added or deducted. This reference is not assigned to Super Record S.

technical_document.title: Campagnolo Super Record Wireless rear derailleur user manual, June 2023

Campagnolo rear-derailleur technical manual, section 1.1: distinct Super Record and Super Record S twelve-speed wireless rows, 37/32/10/16T; not the thirteen-speed row
Campagnolo Super Record Wireless twelve-speed rear derailleur: published 295 g reference; battery inclusion unspecified

specifications.identity_note: Original Super Record Wireless reference only; matching compatibility markings do not establish that Super Record S uses an identical complete assembly
